report.explanation: Alert claims checkout error-rate and latency, but current gateway telemetry is healthy: error_rate 0.0014, p95 75ms, zero dependency timeouts and db pool waiters, OK traces and 200 logs. This contradicts the alert and no downstream service telemetry is available. No evidence supports any bounded root-cause candidate, so hand off for broader telemetry.
